evidence: ref27/System/Applications/Utilities/Activity Monitor.app/Contents/Info.plist (no document types, services or activities)

features.feature: CPU, Memory, Energy, Disk and Network tabs
features.note: Five tabs with per-tab columns and a graph card.
Click a header to sort; arrow shown in header.

features.feature: Process filters (all, mine, other users, system, active, inactive, windowed, GPU, selected)
features.note: Three filters only: all, mine, other users.
features.wire: Add System, Active, Inactive, Windowed, GPU and Selected Processes filters to model::Filter (model.rs:135 keep) and as sidebar rows in window.rs:330 plus a View menu in main.rs main_menu; windowed needs the shell window list over the app SDK, active/inactive uses recent CPU ticks.

features.apple: toolbar filter search field, Edit > Find
features.note: Toolbar search plus Process > Find Process (cmd+F) at main.rs:81.
SIGTERM / SIGKILL via toolbar and Process menu; no confirmation sheet.
features.wire: Show a confirmation sheet (Quit / Force Quit / Cancel) before signalling, as the reference does, in window.rs signal_selected.
Add a Process > Send Signal... item in main.rs:72 that opens a sheet with a signal popup (HUP, INT, KILL, TERM, USR1, USR2, STOP, CONT) and calls window.rs signal_selected(sig).

features.feature: Inspect Process window (stats, memory, open files and ports)
features.apple: ProcessInspector.nib: Memory, Statistics, Open Files and Ports tabs
features.note: Inspector card replaces the graph and lists command, exe, threads and open files/sockets; no separate window, no Memory/Statistics tabs, no parent process or reveal-in-file-manager link.
features.wire: Turn the inspector into its own window with Memory / Statistics / Open Files and Ports segments (inspect.rs adds parent pid, faults, context switches from /proc/<pid>/status), plus a Reveal in Files button for exe.
Add Process > Sample Process: read /proc/<pid>/task/*/stack and wchan over N seconds in a new sample_proc.rs, show the text in a window with Save...

features.apple: View > Run Spindump, Run System Diagnostics
features.wire: Add View > Run System Diagnostics that gathers /proc snapshots, journal tail and dmesg into a tarball on the Desktop via a thread, with a progress sheet.
Store a per-pid baseline when toggled in window.rs and show counters relative to it in the table columns.

Add View > Columns with checkable items per tab (Threads, PID, User, Ports, Kind, Real Mem, Private Mem, Purgeable, Compressed, CPU Time, Idle Wake Ups, Bytes Read/Written...) persisted in app prefs; model::Tab::columns filters by the set.
Add View > Update Frequency radio items (1s/2s/5s) feeding next_wake in window.rs:161; persist it.

features.apple: CPU tab footer graph, Window > CPU History
features.note: Graph card per tab with history; no per-core history and no floating CPU History window.
features.wire: Record per-core shares in sample.rs from /proc/stat cpuN lines and add Window > CPU History opening a floating panel with one strip per core.

features.feature: Floating CPU Usage window and Keep on Top
features.apple: Window > CPU Usage, Keep CPU Windows on Top
features.wire: Add a small always-on-top window via the SDK floating-panel level showing per-core bars.
Expose a dock badge/icon-image API in the SDK and add View > Dock Icon radio menu that renders the chosen live graph into the dock tile.

features.apple: Memory tab footer: pressure graph, app/wired/compressed, cached, swap
features.note: Pressure parsed from PSI; footer shows used/total; no wired/compressed/cache breakdown rows.
features.wire: Extend sample.rs parse_meminfo to Shmem, Buffers, SwapCached and Zswap, and show the breakdown rows in the Memory graph card (draw.rs graph()).

features.apple: Energy tab: Energy Impact, average, App Nap, Preventing Sleep
features.note: Energy impact is an estimate from CPU; no preventing-sleep or 12-hour average.
features.wire: Read inhibitors from logind (systemd-inhibit --list) for a Preventing Sleep column and keep a rolling 12-hour mean per process name.

features.feature: Disk tab: bytes per process and graph
features.note: Per-process read/write bytes from /proc/<pid>/io; system rates from diskstats.

features.apple: Network tab: sent/received bytes and packets per process
features.note: Shows interfaces with totals, not per process; no packets.
features.wire: Add per-process socket attribution (sock_diag) or at least packet counts from /proc/net/dev in model.rs:70 columns.
Read DRM fdinfo (drm-engine-*) per process for a GPU % column and a GPU History window.
Handle Edit > Copy in main.rs menu_action to put the selected row's columns as tab-separated text on the pasteboard.

features.note: Platform help book; no help viewer for system apps.
